stem: New clone material arrives from an external source and looks healthy. What is the strongest intake decision before mixing it with established mother stock?
choices: Mix it immediately because visual inspection is sufficient
Preserve source identity, inspect/quarantine according to risk, and verify plant-health status before integration
Rename it and discard source records
rationale: External plant material can introduce pests, pathogens or identity errors even when symptoms are absent. Intake controls should preserve provenance and separate risk until evaluated.
